# Watering schedule for pots

Yellow lower leaves often mean overwatering rather than a lack of nutrients. Compost needs a balance of green material for nitrogen and brown material for carbon. Turn the compost every week or two to keep it aerobic and free of bad smells.

## Why it matters

Turn the compost every week or two to keep it aerobic and free of bad smells. Water pots deeply and less often so roots grow down instead of staying near the surface. Herbs on a balcony need at least five hours of direct sun and a pot with drainage holes.

Yellow lower leaves often mean overwatering rather than a lack of nutrients. Group plants with similar water needs together so one schedule fits the whole shelf.
